pertanyaan: Berapa jumlah produk di katalog?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products

pertanyaan: Berapa order yang dibatalkan?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'Cancelled'

pertanyaan: Ada berapa kantor di USA?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM offices WHERE country = 'USA'

pertanyaan: Berapa total penjualan tahun 2004?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(d.quantityOrdered * d.priceEach) FROM orderdetails d JOIN orders o ON o.orderNumber = d.orderNumber WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' AND YEAR(o.orderDate) = 2004

pertanyaan: Lini produk mana yang penjualannya paling besar?
gold_sql: SELECT p.productLine FROM orderdetails d JOIN orders o ON o.orderNumber = d.orderNumber JOIN products p ON p.productCode = d.productCode WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY p.productLine ORDER BY SUM(d.quantityOrdered * d.priceEach) DESC LIMIT 1

pertanyaan: Berapa rata-rata nilai per order di tahun 2003?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(t.nilai) FROM (SELECT o.orderNumber, SUM(d.quantityOrdered * d.priceEach) AS nilai FROM orders o JOIN orderdetails d ON d.orderNumber = o.orderNumber WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' AND YEAR(o.orderDate) = 2003 GROUP BY o.orderNumber) t

pertanyaan: Berapa jumlah pelanggan di setiap negara?
gold_sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customerNumber) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customerNumber = c.customerNumber WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY c.country
catatan: Hanya pelanggan yang pernah order. Menghitung semua baris customers akan menghasilkan angka berbeda

pertanyaan: Apa 5 produk dengan laba kotor terbesar?
gold_sql: SELECT p.productCode, p.productName, SUM(d.quantityOrdered * (d.priceEach - p.buyPrice)) AS laba FROM orderdetails d JOIN orders o ON o.orderNumber = d.orderNumber JOIN products p ON p.productCode = d.productCode WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY p.productCode, p.productName ORDER BY laba DESC LIMIT 5
catatan: Jebakan: LLM bisa memakai MSRP sebagai harga jual, padahal harga jual aktual adalah priceEach

pertanyaan: Siapa sales rep dengan total penjualan terbesar?
gold_sql: SELECT CONCAT(e.firstName, ' ', e.lastName) FROM orderdetails d JOIN orders o ON o.orderNumber = d.orderNumber JOIN customers c ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN employees e ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY e.employeeNumber, e.firstName, e.lastName ORDER BY SUM(d.quantityOrdered * d.priceEach) DESC LIMIT 1

pertanyaan: Kantor di kota mana yang menghasilkan penjualan terbesar?
gold_sql: SELECT f.city FROM orderdetails d JOIN orders o ON o.orderNumber = d.orderNumber JOIN customers c ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN employees e ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber JOIN offices f ON f.officeCode = e.officeCode WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY f.city ORDER BY SUM(d.quantityOrdered * d.priceEach) DESC LIMIT 1
catatan: Butuh 5 tabel. Kota kantor berbeda dengan kota pelanggan

pertanyaan: Berapa total piutang seluruh pelanggan yang belum dibayar?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(t.penjualan - COALESCE(p.bayar, 0)) FROM (SELECT o.customerNumber, SUM(d.quantityOrdered * d.priceEach) AS penjualan FROM orders o JOIN orderdetails d ON d.orderNumber = o.orderNumber WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY o.customerNumber) t LEFT JOIN (SELECT customerNumber, SUM(amount) AS bayar FROM payments GROUP BY customerNumber) p ON p.customerNumber = t.customerNumber
catatan: Jebakan fan-out: join orders dan payments langsung tanpa agregasi terpisah akan menggandakan angka

pertanyaan: Pelanggan mana yang piutangnya paling besar?
gold_sql: SELECT c.customerName FROM (SELECT o.customerNumber, SUM(d.quantityOrdered * d.priceEach) AS penjualan FROM orders o JOIN orderdetails d ON d.orderNumber = o.orderNumber WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY o.customerNumber) t LEFT JOIN (SELECT customerNumber, SUM(amount) AS bayar FROM payments GROUP BY customerNumber) p ON p.customerNumber = t.customerNumber JOIN customers c ON c.customerNumber = t.customerNumber ORDER BY t.penjualan - COALESCE(p.bayar, 0) DESC LIMIT 1

pertanyaan: Siapa atasan langsung dari sales rep dengan penjualan terbesar?
gold_sql: SELECT CONCAT(m.firstName, ' ', m.lastName) FROM employees m WHERE m.employeeNumber = (SELECT e.reportsTo FROM orderdetails d JOIN orders o ON o.orderNumber = d.orderNumber JOIN customers c ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN employees e ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY e.employeeNumber, e.reportsTo ORDER BY SUM(d.quantityOrdered * d.priceEach) DESC LIMIT 1)

pertanyaan: Pelanggan mana saja yang punya order berstatus On Hold?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customerName FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber WHERE o.status = 'On Hold'
catatan: Komentar order menyebut alasannya batas kredit terlampaui

pertanyaan: Order mana yang dikirim terlambat?
gold_sql: SELECT orderNumber FROM orders WHERE shippedDate > requiredDate

pertanyaan: Berapa total pembayaran yang diterima setiap tahun?
